title: The Friendship Audit
priceNote: Free on Gumroad. Pay what you want from $0. Instant download.
h1: Most friendships don't end. They fade, because both people are waiting for the other to reach out.
sub: Map your inner, middle and outer circles in ten minutes, see exactly who is fading, and leave with three texts to send this week.
heroMicro: PDF + Google Sheet. No email wall, no course. Fill it in tonight.

uvp.p: Rank up to 25 people by closeness. The sheet flags the ones you have drifted from.
A printable audit you can finish before dinner. No app, no login.
You finish with named people and a message for each, not a vague plan to 'reach out more'.

stat.t: In-person time with friends fell from about 60 minutes a day in 2003 to about 20 in 2020. Friendships rarely end; the time just stops being scheduled.

benefits.h: A clear picture of your circles
benefits.p: Inner, middle and outer circles on one page, so you know who actually holds your week together.
The Google Sheet finds who is slipping, so you do not have to remember to notice.

benefits.h: A first move that is small
benefits.p: Three short texts, written this week, to people who would likely be glad to hear from you.

benefits.h: A way into the full practice
benefits.p: If the audit shows a gap, The 30-Day Friendship Practice picks up exactly where it ends.

insideTitle: A printable and a sheet that does the sorting
insideLead: Both versions cover the same audit. Use paper if you think better with a pen, the sheet if you want the fading list built for you.
inside: Printable audit (PDF). Map your circles and mark who is fading.
Google Sheet. Enter up to 25 people and it finds who is fading.
Three-texts page. Who to message this week, and what to say.
Built from The Social Architecture Playbook by Quiet Leverages.

items.p: List the people in your inner, middle and outer circles.
Note the last time you spoke. The sheet flags the drift.
Choose three people and write one line to each.

faq.q: What if the audit shows I have very few people?
faq.a: That is useful to know, and it is common. The audit shows where to start. The 30-Day Friendship Practice is built for exactly that, with one small drill a day.

faq.q: Is this therapy or advice about loneliness?
faq.a: No. It is a planning worksheet. General education only.

final.h: Three texts this week, to people you already know.
final.p: The audit tells you who. The texts are up to you.
